title: Online Komlós converges to mean curvature flow
summary: We determine the asymptotics of a game inspired by classic vector balancing problems in combinatorial discrepancy theory. In this game, which we call the online Komlós game, two players, Paul and Carol, update the state vector $y$ in $\mathbb{R}^m$, initially placed at $0$. At each round, Paul chooses freely a set of $n$ vectors in the Euclidean unit ball, and Carol chooses, for each such vector, whether to leave it unchanged or reverse its sign.
